請教大家...我現在在跑joint model...但是我跑到後面一直出現Error in solve.default(D) : system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 2.56235e-60.....無法得到結果....可以有沒有高手....指導..這到底是什麼原因??有沒有方法可以解??

fitLME8 <- lme(LF_HF ~ obstime+年齡+BUNpreHD+WBC, random = ~ obstime|id,data = HRV)

fitSURV <- coxph(Surv(SF_foll_mon,Shunt_failure) ~ CrpreHD+K+as.factor(urokinase)+as.factor(PTA)+as.factor(thrombectomy), data = HRV.id, x = TRUE)

fit.JM8 <- jointModel(fitLME8, fitSURV, timeVar = "obstime", method = "Cox-PH-GH")
